prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
For a small business, **Otterly.AI** is a sensible place to start: it’s designed for smaller teams and tracks whether your business appears in answers from ChatGPT and other AI search tools. Its entry plan is reported at about **$25–$29/month**, though pricing and included prompt limits can change. **Rankscale** is another budget option, with plans reported from around **$20/month**.

If you mainly want to check **local-business recommendations**—for example, “best plumber in [city]”—look for a tracker that lets you monitor your own location-specific prompts and compare competitors. A tool’s “visibility” score is only an estimate: AI answers vary by wording, location, account, and time, so no service can guarantee what every customer will see.

Before subscribing, try a free snapshot if available, then test a handful of realistic prompts such as “best [service] near [neighborhood]” and “who should I hire for [problem] in [city]?” Check that the tool shows the actual answers, not just a score.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
